runnerImages.rule: Platform (OS and RID) is a determinism dimension (contract rules.platformDeterminism). Every supported RID in eng/z3-consumers.json is a registered environment. compiler-verifier runs on linux-x64 only, the only platform its release gates use; the protocol establishes nothing for it on another platform and says so in every result. Runner labels are pinned (no -latest label). The runner image version cannot be pinned on hosted runners; every attempt records ImageOS and ImageVersion, and a disagreement is never excused by an image change.
runnerImages.ordinaryCi: test.yml and other workflows also use the floating labels ubuntu-latest and windows-latest; hosted images are not pinnable. The images observed at the freeze are in observedAtFreeze.

checkout.rule: Every environment checks out the committed bytes (git config --global core.autocrlf false before checkout). Inputs are byte-identical on every platform, so any platform difference comes from the code under test. This is an input pin, not a normalization: no output is ever converted. Tracked files must be unmodified before the first attempt and after every invocation (git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no is empty); otherwise that invocation and every later attempt in the job are invalid.

knownOpenItems.item: The contract defines no maintenance or non-0.24 release path; every surface is blocked until #1408 records MILESTONE-SUCCEEDED. A maintenance path needs a #1407 amendment first.

The release PR precedes #1423 and cannot consume an adjudication identity. Whether checking its products (version, rendered notes) against the record satisfies §8 condition 7, or the row needs an amendment, is undecided.

The release gate compares rebuilt bytes with C2-recorded hashes and fails closed where a build is not byte-reproducible. #1526 makes both NuGet packages, the release metadata, and the website byte-reproducible, and #1527 makes the B2 headline depend only on the candidate. Residuals recorded by #1526: rebuilds must use the same .NET SDK build (a source-built SDK 10.0.401 packs different bytes), and the site downloads Google Fonts at build time. C2 regeneration 2 must show that rebuilt bytes equal its recorded hashes.

Recommended settings not enforceable by a workflow: environment-scoped NUGET_API_KEY with a main-only policy; branch protection without admin bypass and with tests (verification) required; a v* tag ruleset; github-pages deployments restricted to main; a red release-audit run treated as a gate bypass.

G3 is not closed on the candidate. Execution 2 (DETERMINISTIC, 2,137 AGREE-PASS) ran on d42d0313 under protocol 1.3.0, before the S2 repairs and protocol amendment 1.4.0, so it establishes nothing for this candidate. C2 (#1517) committed its records. C2 regeneration 2 runs protocol 1.4.0 on the candidate (the last of 3 executions; charged to regeneration-compute, contract amendment 1.2.0).
